source: docs/audit/BLUEPRINT_VERIFICATION.md -- the strict seven-mark re-score of every blueprint the principal gave on 2026-09-29 (138 rows, scored 2026-09-30 13:30Z at LIVE d30be2ce); converted to data 2026-11-03 so a machine re-scores it hourly (BACKLOG rows 20 and 82)
rule: A row is DONE only when all seven marks hold on THIS host: I (cited code exists), W (a clock the repo knows names it), A (authoritative), T (a test names it), R (a named artifact exists here and is under 72 h old), D (this checkout is LIVE), C (consistent). I, W, T, R and D are MEASURED by scripts/check_blueprint_score.py every hour; A and C are judgements recorded here, and a recorded mark older than mark_ttl_days reads UNMEASURED. The derived state is the minimum of the row's claim and its evidence; a row that claims DONE without proof is a lie that fails the fence. Edit this file, never the Markdown matrix.
